excerpt: For a locally noetherian adic space X over Spa(Q_p, Z_p), define on X_proet the uncompleted structure sheaf O_X = ν^* O_{X_et} with O_X^+ = ν^* O^+_{X_et}, the integral completed structure sheaf Ô_X^+ = lim O_X^+/p^n and Ô_X = Ô_X^+[1/p]. For U ∈ X_proet: every x ∈ |U| gives a continuous valuation f ↦ |f(x)| on O_X(U) which extends to Ô_X(U); O_X^+(U) = {f ∈ O_X(U) : |f(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} and Ô_X^+(U) = {f ∈ Ô_X(U) : |f(x)| ≤ 1 for all x}, so Ô_X^+(U) ⊂ Ô_X(U) is integrally closed; O_X^+/p^n → Ô_X^+/p^n is an isomorphism of sheaves and Ô_X^+(U) is flat over Z_p and p-adically complete.
